question.question: What sports activity is Calvin planning to try after the tour with Frank Ocean?

evidence_items.text:
Calvin: Hey Dave! Been a few days since we talked, but lots happened. Started touring with Frank Ocean and it's been amazing - so much energy from the crowd, such a connection when I'm on stage - unreal! Take a look at how I performed on stage, that was awesome!
[Image caption: a photo of a band performing on stage with bright lights]
[S24T1] (dia_id: D24:1)

Dave: Congrats, Calvin! That's awesome. Being able to play your music to a crowd and feel that connection must be unreal. How's the tour going?
[S24T2] (dia_id: D24:2)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! The tour has been great, the energy from the crowd is awesome and jamming with Frank Ocean is a dream come true. It's been amazing!
[S24T3] (dia_id: D24:3)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! I bet performing with him is like a dream come true! How did it happen?
[S24T4] (dia_id: D24:4)

Calvin: It all started August last year when we met at a festival and he said he wanted to collaborate. We clicked right away and the chemistry on stage was incredible. I'm so lucky! Check the photo, of how we perfectly look together on stage!
[Image caption: a photo of a band performing on stage with a projection of a man on the wall]
[S24T5] (dia_id: D24:5)

Dave: Wow, Calvin - you and Frank are so in tune! It's clear you both rock on stage. Can't wait to catch your show!
[S24T6] (dia_id: D24:6)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I'm so excited you'll be at one of our shows. It's such a great experience, you'll definitely enjoy it! Look at this crowd, that was insane!
[Image caption: a photo of a large crowd of people in a large auditorium]
[S24T7] (dia_id: D24:7)

Dave: That sounds really exciting! Can't wait to experience it. I'm sure everyone in the crowd is going to be pumped up!
[S24T8] (dia_id: D24:8)

- On 2023-10-04, when Dave asked what he works on to relax, Calvin shared a photo of a shiny orange car with its hood open and said he loves working on this project "to chill out" (a car project Calvin is working on himself — distinct from his own Ferrari, see ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26); makes sense given his long-standing finding that working on/fixing cars relaxes him "like meditation," see the 2023-05-31 entry in ## Relationships) [S21T3].
- On 2023-10-15, when Dave (feeling discouraged after his shop lost a deal to a competitor) asked how he stays motivated when faced with setbacks: "When setbacks come my way, I remind myself why I'm passionate about my goals. I rely on helpful people around me and take a break to recharge with my favorite activities. That always helps me get back to feeling motivated." (complements his earlier 2023-07-21 answer about staying motivated, see above) [S23T3][S23T4].
- On 2023-10-15, said performing with Frank Ocean "recently has been really cool" — said while reacting to Dave's music-festival story (see ## Relationships); the Frank Ocean tour he described to Dave on 2023-08-14 as having ended with the Tokyo show predates this remark, which suggests more recent performing with Frank Ocean (details in ## Frank Ocean collaboration; confirmed on 2023-10-19, when he told Dave he has started touring with Frank Ocean — see ## Frank Ocean collaboration) [S23T10].
- On 2023-10-23, on the balance and pressure of touring/fame (complementing his earlier motivation answers, see above): the tour is incredible and energizing, but fame has its own challenges — balancing it all has been tough; he takes it one day at a time, it can get overwhelming with so many demands, but he enjoys what he does so he pushes on; a strong support system is a key strategy — his friends and team keep him on track [S25T2][S25T4][S25T6].
- On 2023-10-23, when Dave asked (after Dave shared his good conversation with neighbors about current events and politics) how he stays informed and inspired: staying connected and up-to-date on world events is important to him — it helps his music stand out by incorporating unique perspectives, connects him better with his fans, and keeps him motivated and inspired [S25T8].

Dave: Hey Calvin, how's the tour with Frank Ocean? I was pondering our chat the other day about fame and its impact on relationships. It must be awesome but it must have its own struggles too. How are you juggling your job plus your personal life?
[S25T1] (dia_id: D25:1)

Calvin: The tour's been incredible! Performing and connecting with the crowd has been so energizing. Yeah, fame has its own challenges. It's been tough trying to balance everything.
[S25T2] (dia_id: D25:2)

Dave: How are you managing everything? Do you ever feel overwhelmed?
[S25T3] (dia_id: D25:3)

Calvin: I take it one day at a time, but it can get overwhelming with so many demands. Still, I enjoy what I do so I push on.
[S25T4] (dia_id: D25:4)

Dave: Glad you're finding joy in what you do! Any strategies that help you manage everything?
[S25T5] (dia_id: D25:5)

Calvin: Yeah, having a strong support system is really helpful. My friends and team keep me on track.
[S25T6] (dia_id: D25:6)

evidence_items.section: # Calvin > ## Boston trip (planned as of 2023-04-20; Frank Ocean tour stop as of 2023-05-31; personal visit July 2023)
evidence_items.text:
- Plans to make a trip to Boston after he finishes the Frank Ocean tour; has heard the music scene there is awesome and is excited to check it out [S3T9].
- Not yet seen Boston apart from gigs — he has been busy with rehearsals and traveling [S3T14][S3T15].
- Looking forward to exploring the city, trying out delicious food, and visiting popular attractions [S3T15].
- Dave (apparently Boston-based) is offering to show him around — including Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park — and to take him to his favorite food spots; Calvin proposed grabbing a bite together when he is in Boston, and Dave agreed [S3T10][S3T15][S3T16] (see /memories/dave.md > ## Boston).
- Calvin is looking forward to trying the food in Boston with Dave and called it fun ("Can't wait to try out the food there with you") [S3T17].
- As of 2023-05-31, the Boston visit is part of the Frank Ocean tour: "Cool, can't wait for the tour with Frank!" — he's "buzzing to perform in Boston and see what it's like" and "Gonna be great playing for folks from home" (calling Boston's folks "from home" suggests it is where he's from, though not stated outright). He asked Dave what he thinks of the music scene there; Dave: it's "awesome — Tons of talented musicians and cool places to play," and he'll be there to cheer Calvin on (details in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston) [S7T15][S7T16].
- On 2023-06-09, said he has never been to Boston before but has heard the parks are amazing — "can't wait to visit next month" (i.e., July 2023); he wants to take walks in the Boston parks to experience their serenity and recharge, and asked Dave what cool things he remembers about them; shared a photo of a tree with pink flowers (likely from the album session); Dave's recollections of the Boston parks are in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston [S8T5][S8T7].
- As of 2023-08-22, said his tour ends soon and he's heading to Boston, and proposed meeting up with Dave then — "Maybe we can meet up then!" (renewing the earlier plan to meet in Boston, see above); Dave: "Fill me in on the details when you have them and let's meet up when you're here. Can't wait to hear all about everything!" (Note: the 2023-08-14 update described the Frank Ocean tour as already having ended with the Tokyo show, so this "tour ends soon" may be a continuation or a new tour — unconfirmed) [S15T10][S15T11].
- On 2023-09-02, told Dave he booked a flight to Boston "last week" (~2023-08-26 through 09-01) and is "so excited" about the upcoming Boston trip, sharing a photo of a book with a boarding pass on it — "See you soon, buddy!"; he'll let Dave know when he's in Boston, and Dave told him to let him know when he's free so they can catch up in Boston (continuing the plan to meet up in Boston, see above) [S17T6][S17T7][S17T8]. The chat closed with Dave: "Looking forward to seeing you! Have a safe trip, see ya!"; Calvin thanked Dave, reciprocated the safe-trip wishes ("Gotta stay safe on the trip"), said "Can't wait to see you there!", and promised he will contact Dave when he arrives [S17T9][S17T10].
- On 2023-09-13, re-pledged the plan to let Dave know when he's in Boston — "I'll let you know when I'm in Boston" — and accepted Dave's offer to check out his garage and its cool cars (Dave shared a photo of the garage — a car in a garage with a Coca-Cola sign — "looks stunning!"), saying it would be fun and might give him ideas for future projects (details in ## Relationships; Dave's side in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston) [S18T11][S18T12].

Calvin: Hey Dave! Been ages since we chatted. So much has gone down. Touring with Frank Ocean last week was wild. Tokyo was unreal -- the crowd was insane. I felt so alive when performing, can't find the words to express it.
[S7T1] (dia_id: D7:1)

Dave: Wow, that's awesome, Cal! I bet it was an incredible experience. Congrats! Look what I've been up to recently, that's my neighbor's car. He's been having some trouble with the engine, but now it's done by myself!
[Image caption: a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage]
[S7T2] (dia_id: D7:2)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! It was an amazing experience - the energy and love from the fans was crazy. The car in the pic? It's the one you were fixing up the engine for a friend? Working on cars helps me chill and clear my head.
[S7T3] (dia_id: D7:3)

Dave: Yes, Cal! It's not difficult for me to help my neighbors with their cars. Working on cars is definitely therapeutic. Does it relax you as much as it does me?
[S7T4] (dia_id: D7:4)

Calvin: Yeah, totally! Fixing cars really calms me down and gives me a real sense of achievement - like meditating. Do you have any hobbies that give you the same satisfaction?
[S7T5] (dia_id: D7:5)

Dave: I'm passionate about fixing up things. It's more than just a hobby - it gives me a sense of achievement and purpose. I get a real buzz transforming something that's not working into something that runs smoothly - it's like giving it a second chance.
[S7T6] (dia_id: D7:6)

- On 2023-08-14, updated Dave that the tour with the well-known artist (the Frank Ocean tour, see above) ended with a show in Japan — the Tokyo show was "awesome": everyone was "so into it" when he played one of his songs and sang along, which he called "a magical moment"; feeling of performing and connecting with the audience "was unreal"; after the tour he had the opportunity to explore his new place (the Japanese mansion, see ## New home (2023-03-23)) — "it's like a dream come true!" [S14T4][S14T6].
- On 2023-08-31, when Dave asked how the end of the tour was, Calvin said the tour was amazing — he was "so pumped from all the energy from the audience" — and shared a photo of a crowd watching a concert with a large screen ("This pic totally captures how I felt. Such an amazing time!"); when Dave asked how it was performing on that big stage, Calvin said it was "a dream come true" — the energy was incredible, he "felt on top of the world", and it was "seriously surreal" [S16T2][S16T3][S16T4].
- On 2023-10-19, told Dave he has started touring with Frank Ocean ("lots happened" since they last talked) — "it's been amazing": so much energy from the crowd and "such a connection when I'm on stage — unreal!"; the tour "has been great" and "jamming with Frank Ocean is a dream come true" (another Frank Ocean tour after the earlier ones listed here — Dave is looking forward to attending one of its shows, see the 2023-10-19 entry in ## Relationships) [S24T1][S24T3].
- On 2023-10-19, shared another photo of the tour crowd: a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air — "Wow, the crowd energy is amazing! It always gets me so pumped and it's awesome. Look at that photo, that was awesome!"; when Dave asked where it was taken, Calvin said it was taken in Tokyo during a concert — "the energy was nuts - felt like the whole city came out!" (Dave's enthusiasm about visiting Tokyo, see /memories/dave.md > ## Japan) [S24T9][S24T10][S24T11].
- On 2023-10-19, announced he's actually going to Tokyo in November 2023 ("next month") after the tour ends — shared a photo of a city at night with a tall building in the background ("What a great view!") and said "Sometimes I wish I could go back to places like [that]"; spots he's excited to check out: Shibuya Crossing — "like Tokyo's Times Square" — and Shinjuku; he can't wait to try the amazing food there again (shared a photo of Shibuya Crossing at night — a crowd of people with umbrellas in the rain); he has never tried ramen but "it's supposed to be awesome" — "Gonna give it a shot while in Tokyo!" — after Dave (who tried ramen in Boston) encouraged him (Dave's side in /memories/dave.md > ## Japan) [S24T17][S24T19][S24T21].

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Excited to drive again. Appreciate your help! Look what a wonderful view from living room!
[Image caption: a photo of a view of a small town with a mountain in the background]
[S9T11] (dia_id: D9:11)

Dave: Wow, what an amazing view! Where is it? I haven't seen anything like that before!
[S9T12] (dia_id: D9:12)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! It's from a small town in Japan. The view of the mountains is unbelievably stunning!
[S9T13] (dia_id: D9:13)

Dave: Wow! Did you get to that place yet?
[S9T14] (dia_id: D9:14)

Calvin: Nope, not yet! I haven't been there before, but it's on my to-do list for after my tour with Frank Ocean ends. Can't wait to see them in person! Look at that snowy peak.
[Image caption: a photo of a person on skis on a snowy mountain]
[S9T15] (dia_id: D9:15)

Dave: Looks awesome! Have you ever tried skiing before? It looks like loads of fun!
[S9T16] (dia_id: D9:16)

Calvin: Haven't tried it before, but it does look like a lot of fun! I might give it a try once. So what's up with you, is anything new in your daily routine?
[S9T17] (dia_id: D9:17)

Dave: Yes, Cal! I recently joined a rock band and have been practicing guitar. Look at this photo – it's us, the guys! 
[Image caption: a photography of a group of men playing instruments in a room]
[S9T18] (dia_id: D9:18)

Calvin: Playing guitar in a rock band is awesome, Dave! It will bring you a lot of emotions.
[S9T19] (dia_id: D9:19)

Dave: Sounds good, Calvin! Good company and great music, lift the mood and bring a lot of positive emotions! I have to go now. I'll see you soon!
[S9T20] (dia_id: D9:20)

Calvin: Dave, thanks for checking in. I'm feeling stoked about this album! We've been making some magic with a team in the studio, working on the music and everything. Look at what a wonderful studio we have! How have you been? Anything new since we talked?
[Image caption: a photo of a recording studio with a large window and a desk]
[S8T3] (dia_id: D8:3)

Dave: Hey, nice photo of the studio! Working in a team yields incredible results, well done! Keep pushing it! I've been doing good - thanks for asking. I've been exploring some parks on the weekends to relax - it's so peaceful being surrounded by nature. Are there any chill spots you enjoy in Boston?
[S8T4] (dia_id: D8:4)

Calvin: Thanks! That studio is great for creativity. I've never been to Boston before, but I hear the parks are amazing. Can't wait to visit next month. Anything cool you remember about Boston parks?
[Image caption: a photo of a tree with pink flowers in the foreground]
[S8T5] (dia_id: D8:5)

Dave: That sounds great! The Boston parks are awesome, especially in spring. It's so serene when you're walking around. I went for a stroll last Friday and it was amazing. It's so magical - I bet you'll love it! I love taking walks on the weekends, they recharge me for the entire upcoming week!
[S8T6] (dia_id: D8:6)

Calvin: I'm excited to experience that serenity. I can't wait to take a walk in the parks and recharge. Hey, have you been on any hikes lately?
[Image caption: a photo of a path going up a hill with a view of the mountains]
[S8T7] (dia_id: D8:7)

Dave: Nah, haven't gone hiking recently, but it's awesome - being in nature and pushing yourself to new heights. Clears your mind and brings a sense of calm. Have you been to the mountains before? Heard they're super chill.
[S8T8] (dia_id: D8:8)

Calvin: Nah, haven't been to the mountains but I'm keen to go. Looking for a way to escape it all and de-stress. I want to go on a hike to a place similar to this. What's new and exciting happening for you, Dave?
[Image caption: a photo of a plane flying over a mountain range with snow on the top]
[S8T9] (dia_id: D8:9)

Dave: I booked a trip to a mountainous region for next month! Finally gonna be able to see those majestic peaks! Gonna be an amazing experience!
[S8T10] (dia_id: D8:10)

Calvin: Cool, Dave! Have a great time. I'm sure it's going to be an amazing experience. Take lots of pics and show me when you get back.
[S8T11] (dia_id: D8:11)

Dave: Yep, Calvin! Gonna take lots of pics. Can't wait to show you when I get back!
[S8T12] (dia_id: D8:12)

Calvin: Have fun exploring the mountains, Dave! Safe travels and see you soon. Take care!
[S8T13] (dia_id: D8:13)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Take care, see you soon!
[S8T14] (dia_id: D8:14)
